supporting_observations.claim: WS-NKIM-01 made seven recurring HTTPS CONNECT requests from 13:40:40 through 14:10:39 UTC to update.casebinder.co, at intervals of roughly five minutes.
The observed destination is update.casebinder.co, whereas the inventory lists the approved CaseBinder update host as update.casebinder.com; these are different hostnames.

The recurring connections are associated with casebinderupd.exe running from Noah Kim's per-user AppData directory, rather than the inventory-listed C:\Program Files\CaseBinder\casebinderupd.exe path.
The process wrote to its own executable path shortly after starting; the record establishes a file creation event but does not establish what content was written or why.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT hostnames and tunnel metadata, not the encrypted HTTP requests, response content, or downloaded payload.
The logged workstation connections terminate at the explicit proxy; these records do not provide the external server's resolved IP address or independently verify the remote endpoint.
The available records do not establish the executable's hash, signer, provenance, or whether it is an authorized per-user CaseBinder installation.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish that data was exfiltrated or that a payload was downloaded or executed.
The evidence does not establish who controls update.casebinder.co or whether the hostname is vendor-authorized.
The executable name and observed network behavior alone do not establish that the process is genuine CaseBinder software or malware.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect the executable's hash, digital-signature status, file metadata, and origin; compare them with a verified vendor-distributed CaseBinder build.
Review endpoint file and process telemetry around the executable's creation and execution, including any child processes and files it created or modified.
Obtain proxy/DNS and, if available, TLS inspection or endpoint network telemetry to verify the remote endpoint and determine what the recurring sessions transferred.
Confirm with the software owner or vendor whether update.casebinder.co and a per-user AppData installation are authorized.
unrelated_findings: WS-NKIM-01 recorded repeated failed interactive logons for noah.kim at 13:48 and 14:08 UTC; their cause is not established by these records. Review separately. (T145-00196, T145-00197, T145-00265, T145-00266, T145-00267)

A WmiPrvSE.exe process accessed svchost.exe with GrantedAccess 0x1400 before the alerted CaseBinder connections; the records do not establish whether this was expected. Review separately if warranted. (T145-00035)
